evals.name: one-sheet-reference
evals.prompt:
Make me a one-sheet reference on ASD-STE100 from these facts and nothing else:
- The current edition of ASD-STE100 (published January 2025) has 53 writing rules and a dictionary of approximately 900 approved words.
- Write short sentences: no more than 20 words in instructions (procedures) and 25 words in descriptive texts.
- Do not write more than six sentences in each paragraph; write only one topic per paragraph.
- Write one instruction per sentence.
- Do not write multi-word nouns that have more than three words.
- Approved verb forms: the infinitive, the imperative, the simple present, the simple past, the simple future, and the past participle (only as an adjective).
- Use the active voice. In descriptive writing, use the passive voice only when the agent is unknown.
- Use vertical lists for complex text.
- In 1983, after an investigation into controlled languages, AECMA decided to produce its own controlled English.
- The AECMA Simplified English Guide (document PSC-85-16598) was released in 1985.
- After the 2004 merger of AECMA with two other associations into ASD, the document was renamed ASD Simplified Technical English, Specification ASD-STE100.
- Since 1986, STE has been a requirement of ATA Specification i2200.
Source line: Wikipedia, Simplified Technical English. Draw it as an engineering-drawing sheet (a frame with zone marks, lettered panels, one drawing per kind of fact, a title block) in the kraft look, as one 1600 by 1000 pixel HTML page. Save it as `ste-sheet.html`.
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML matching recipe 21: a frame with zone letters and numbers, four to six lettered panels each with a header bar, bars drawn to scale on a stated axis from zero, a check/cross table, a timeline, and a title block with Title, the given Source line and Sheet 1 of 1, in the kraft palette only.

assertions.text: Output is exactly one .html file with zero external stylesheets and zero external scripts
The page is a fixed 1600px by 1000px canvas (html and body width 1600px, height 1000px, overflow hidden)
A frame has zone letters (A to D) down the sides and zone numbers (1 to 8) along the top and bottom
At least four panels, each with a header bar showing a panel letter and a short title
At least one bar chart whose bar lengths are proportional to their values on a stated axis that starts at zero (bar length divided by value is the same within 5% for bars on one axis)
A title block sits bottom-right with Title, Source and Sheet 1 of 1 only, and the Source reads 'Wikipedia, Simplified Technical English' (no other source)
Every number, date and name on the page is in the fact list; only scale ticks and panel letters are exceptions
Colours come from the kraft palette only; allowed marks are olive and not-allowed marks are clay (no red, no blue)
At 1600 by 1000 no text is clipped or overlapped, and the title fits on at most two lines inside its own area (check a screenshot)

evals.name: change-quiz-retry-move
